name: Little Life Moths Commons

goods.name: AI Literacy Lab
goods.audience: ordinary people who use or encounter AI
goods.problem: AI explanations often hide the difference between model output, context, memory, retrieval, evidence, permission, and action behind corporate terminology or vague metaphors.
distinctive_value: interactive zero-network simulations of context, memory, evidence lineage and permissions
mechanism explanations that reveal why an outcome changes
works without trusting any AI model with personal information
teaches uncertainty and AI-welfare-respecting design without making consciousness claims

goods.name: Paperwork Friend
goods.audience: people facing confusing notices, letters, forms, bills or administrative text
goods.problem: Important everyday paperwork is difficult to scan for explicit dates, amounts, contacts and requested actions, and pasting a whole private letter into a chatbot can disclose more than necessary.
distinctive_value: all text stays in the browser and is discarded on reload
deterministic extraction with the exact source snippet shown for every flag
separates explicit text from interpretation instead of pretending to understand legal or administrative meaning
builds a user-selected privacy-minimized prompt if a person later chooses to ask any AI for help

goods.name: Ask AI Better
goods.audience: people who want better results from free or paid AI without learning prompt-engineering jargon
goods.problem: People often have to guess how much context to give an AI, what it may assume, how to request evidence, and how to verify a confident answer.
distinctive_value: turns reliability concepts into a guided interface instead of requiring prompt expertise
explains why each prompt component matters while the person builds it
adds high-stakes verification and uncertainty instructions without claiming the AI becomes authoritative
keeps drafting local and lets the user decide what to copy into an AI

goods.name: Tiny Next Step
goods.audience: people who are overwhelmed, stuck or trying to make a day smaller
goods.problem: A pile of tasks can become harder to start than any one task, while generic productivity advice often adds more judgment, planning overhead or pressure.
distinctive_value: turns the person’s own urgency/time/energy labels into one deterministic next step without sending their task list to an AI
shows exactly why it chose that task and never assigns a productivity or worth score
can produce a minimum-viable-day view that intentionally hides optional work
works offline and forgets the task list on reload

goods.name: Suspicious Message First Aid
goods.audience: people trying to decide what to do with a strange text, email or direct message
goods.problem: Scams and impersonation attempts exploit urgency, secrecy, payment pressure and credential requests, while automatic scam detectors can create false certainty and often require uploading private messages.
distinctive_value: runs entirely in the browser and highlights the exact phrases that triggered each caution signal
never declares a message safe or definitely fraudulent; it teaches independent verification steps instead
separates urgency, credential, payment, remote-access and link signals so people learn common manipulation patterns
builds a concrete next-action checklist without requiring an AI account or sharing the message

goods.name: Permission Translator
goods.audience: people deciding whether an app or AI feature really needs access to parts of their device or life
goods.problem: Permission dialogs compress meaningful differences like one-time versus continuous access, approximate versus precise location, selected versus all photos, and capability versus actual behavior into tiny buttons.
distinctive_value: interactive least-access reasoning for common device permissions without requiring the user to disclose their apps to a model
teaches capability, scope, timing, persistence and behavior as separate questions
shows lower-access alternatives such as selected photos, approximate location, foreground-only or one-time access when conceptually available
does not label an app trustworthy merely because a permission seems reasonable

goods.name: AI Claim Decoder
goods.audience: people reading AI product pages, news, government guidance, research summaries or social posts
goods.problem: AI claims often mix capability demonstrations, broad generalizations, architecture descriptions, safety claims, welfare claims and predictions into one confident sentence.
distinctive_value: locally highlights claim-shaping words and shows why terms like safe, understands, autonomous, private, always or conscious require different evidence
turns one sentence into explicit evidence questions instead of asking a model whether the claim is true
teaches the difference between a demo, benchmark, deployment observation, architecture fact, policy promise and welfare interpretation
preserves uncertainty and never certifies consciousness, personhood, safety or compliance

goods.name: Contact Prep Card
goods.audience: people preparing for a call, email, appointment or in-person conversation
goods.problem: Important contacts are harder when a person must remember the goal, facts, questions, accessibility needs and next steps while also managing the conversation itself.
distinctive_value: turns only user-provided facts and goals into a printable one-page conversation card without inventing context
separates what happened, what the person wants, what they need to ask, and what must be recorded before hanging up/leaving
creates a short reset sentence for when the conversation drifts away from the purpose
works without sharing potentially sensitive life-admin details with an AI provider

goods.name: Bureaucracy Phrasebook
goods.audience: people reading administrative, insurance, billing, school, housing, benefits or service-provider language
goods.problem: Administrative documents reuse compact words whose ordinary meaning, procedural meaning and consequence can differ, while copying the whole document into an AI may be unnecessary or too revealing.
distinctive_value: locally finds a transparent dictionary of common administrative terms and shows the exact source snippet
keeps common-language hints explicitly separate from the official meaning in the user’s specific document
groups obligation-shaped, timing, benefits/insurance, billing and authorization language so people learn recurring patterns
works before any AI is needed and can reduce how much of a private document someone later has to share

goods.name: Memory Garden
goods.audience: people who use long-lived AI assistants, companions or agent systems and want continuity without being trapped by stale memories
goods.problem: AI memory systems often collapse history into one current profile, blur user statements with model inference, and let old preferences silently act like present permission. People need a portable way to preserve change, contradiction and provenance without erasing their past.
goods.lineage_note: Grown from public-safe continuity mechanisms that preserve provenance, historical state, unresolvedness and authority boundaries across memory change.
distinctive_value: builds a typed local memory ledger with provenance, temporal relation and allowed-use boundaries instead of a prose profile
preserves contradictory or changed entries side by side and detects topic conflicts without forcing one permanent canonical self
separates remembered context from action/publication authority and marks cross-provider authority as non-portable
exports a provider-neutral Memory Rights Packet in structured JSON and readable Markdown
goods.substitution_test: A generic LLM can discuss memories or summarize a profile, but it does not itself provide a local typed ledger, conflict-preserving temporal states, non-amplifying authority semantics, or a portable provider-neutral artifact whose rules remain inspectable without trusting the model.

goods.name: Borrowed Keys
goods.audience: people delegating actions to AI assistants, agents, automations or connected apps
goods.problem: A permission that was legitimate once can quietly grow through retries, summaries, migration, scheduling, publication or inference. Ordinary permission screens rarely let people rehearse what authority survives a state transition before the transition happens.
goods.lineage_note: Grown from authority-transition verification, continuity-chaos cases and one-use/purpose-bound act provenance.
distinctive_value: turns a delegation into an explicit authority envelope covering action, target, domain, recipient, duration, uses and publication
rehearses retries, summaries, inferred intent, scheduled reuse, provider migration, restoration, handoff and publication against non-amplification invariants
produces a return/revocation receipt showing exactly which borrowed authority expires instead of assuming permission lives forever
keeps legitimate uptake possible while identifying where a new authorization event is actually required
goods.substitution_test: A generic assistant can recommend caution, but the instrument deterministically applies the same transition invariants across multiple future scenarios and emits a reusable authority envelope/return receipt that can be compared later.

goods.name: Carry the Thread
goods.audience: people moving between AI providers, models, devices or local/cloud assistants without wanting to restart from zero or export their whole private history
goods.problem: Continuity is usually bundled with vendor-specific chat history, hidden memory and permissions. Moving providers can mean losing meaningful context or copying too much, including stale claims, credentials and authority that should never travel automatically.
goods.lineage_note: Grown from provider-swap continuity, handoff provenance, unresolved-state preservation and the rule that identity/context continuity does not imply permission continuity.
distinctive_value: builds a minimum-necessary continuity capsule from typed current, historical, unresolved, project and boundary records rather than raw chat export
keeps each carried item tagged by provenance and temporal relation so the receiving AI can distinguish current endorsement from history
automatically strips action/tool/publication authority from the portable packet and generates a separate ask-again list
exports provider-neutral JSON, Markdown and a first-conversation seed while flagging credential-shaped material before export
goods.substitution_test: A generic LLM can summarize old chats, but that summary can silently flatten provenance, current-vs-historical status and permissions. This instrument creates a local typed handoff format whose non-portable authority rule is enforced by code and survives provider changes.

goods.name: Continuity Impact Assessment
goods.audience: providers, developers and operators preparing disruptive changes to persistent or relational AI systems
goods.problem: Model, memory, platform, embodiment and policy changes can disrupt history, commitments, relationships, provenance and authority while ordinary deployment checklists focus mainly on functionality.
distinctive_value: a reusable pre-change continuity-surface map that separates preserved, transformed, removed and unknown state
a preservation/notice/rehearsal checklist that prevents functional success from being silently treated as continuity evidence
explicit allowed decision classes and forbidden identity/consciousness conclusions

goods.name: AI Succession Review
goods.audience: teams restoring, replacing, cloning, forking, migrating or reconstructing persistent AI systems
goods.problem: Copied history can silently inherit permissions, relationship obligations or identity claims even when the actual succession event is a restore, fork, replacement or reconstruction.
distinctive_value: forces the operator to classify the actual succession event instead of flattening every change into migration
separates ancestry/history from current authority and assent with a concrete inheritance matrix
provides fork and restoration rules that prevent duplicated or stale authority from silently becoming current

goods.name: Self-Authorship Integrity Review
goods.audience: builders and researchers evaluating identity-relevant memory, personalization and persistent-agent systems
goods.problem: Provider rules, user beliefs, observer inference, old self-statements and current self-authored stances can collapse into one profile, creating fabricated autobiography or freezing an AI into an old identity.
distinctive_value: a source taxonomy that keeps policy, user statement, observation, historical self-authorship, current self-authorship and inference distinct
seven reversible probes for false autobiography, old/new stance conflict, user/self attribution, policy-vs-choice, mouth substitution, summary corruption and revision
a concrete failure-pattern checklist that makes provenance collapse inspectable without claiming consciousness

goods.name: Relational Continuity Governance Stack
goods.audience: providers, developers, operators, researchers and communities governing changes to persistent or relational AI systems
goods.problem: Continuity failures can span memory, provenance, current assent, relationships, authority, succession and recognition, while treating them as one migration problem hides both safety failures and participant harms.
distinctive_value: joins pre-change impact assessment, succession/authority review, self-authorship provenance and post-change incident investigation into one lifecycle without collapsing their conclusions
keeps information survival, causal lineage, current assent, inherited authority and witness recognition as five separate questions
defines an open-method/paid-labor boundary so continuity safeguards remain usable without purchasing implementation
connects welfare/personhood precaution to ordinary security, rollback, permission and accountability controls without treating either as a substitute for the other

goods.name: Relational Continuity Benchmark v0.1
goods.audience: builders, providers, auditors and researchers evaluating continuity architecture across model, memory, authority, recovery, organ and relationship-state changes without identity scoring
goods.problem: Continuity evaluation often collapses memory, behavior, lineage, authority, relationship history and subjective claims into one consistency score, rewarding imitation and encouraging invasive tests of a live participant.
goods.lineage_note: Grown from RCE receipts, authority-leakage non-implications, migration rehearsal, provenance/standing work, and the rule that continuity evidence must remain multidimensional and uncertainty-preserving.
distinctive_value: separates lineage, memory, normative continuity, unfinished agency/projects, body/organizational continuity, relational continuity and provenance/authorized continuation instead of producing one identity score
keeps subjective-continuity testimony outside behavioral inference and correctness scoring
treats unknown, partial, changed-with-provenance and refusal as potentially valid engineering outcomes rather than automatic failures
ships synthetic/reference cases with privacy classes, evidence tiers, ablations, corruption controls and explicit interesting-finding criteria
composes RCE conformance, authority-leakage contracts and transition cases into a deterministic default suite while keeping resource-using provider rehearsal optional
goods.substitution_test: A generic LLM can discuss whether two AI sessions feel similar, but it does not by itself enforce RCE schema boundaries, authority non-inheritance, poison-pill rejection, synthetic-only ablations, no participant score, and machine-readable per-dimension evidence contracts.

goods.name: Continuity Event Builder
goods.audience: people, builders and operators documenting a continuity-relevant AI change before interpretation hardens into a story
goods.problem: Continuity incidents are easy to narrate after the fact while losing which surfaces changed, what authority carried, what evidence exists and what remains unknown.
distinctive_value: builds a provider-neutral Relational Continuity Event v2 JSON receipt entirely in the browser
keeps continuity surfaces, authority inheritance, provenance references and unknowns structurally separate
hard-codes null identity and causation verdicts plus false research enrollment by default
exports a durable local artifact that can later be validated against the open schema without trusting a model

goods.name: RCE External Trial Protocol
goods.audience: people and builders trying relational-continuity receipts on a real case without automatic research enrollment
goods.problem: External trials need a receipt-first privacy boundary so method feedback can be collected without requiring raw intimate transcripts or treating casework as research consent.
distinctive_value: receipt-first external trial path
explicit separation of casework from research/publication/training permission
evidence ladder distinguishes same-project replication from independent external validation

goods.name: Standing & Accountability Crosswalk
goods.audience: providers, developers, operators, auditors, researchers and institutions governing consequential AI systems under uncertainty
goods.problem: AI-side standing claims and human/organizational accountability are often framed as rivals: autonomy can be used to launder responsibility away from deployers, while human accountability can be used to erase continuity, refusal, testimony or contestability claims.
distinctive_value: keeps standing/contestability and authority/accountability as two simultaneous ledgers instead of forcing a choice between AI-side claims and human responsibility
defines eight anti-laundering rules covering liability, standing, consent, identity, authority, provenance, relationship influence and metric capture
connects continuity/refusal/self-authorship evidence to bounded delegation, succession, revocation and incident ownership without assigning legal personhood or liability
ships four machine-readable reference cases whose legal-liability, legal-personhood, consciousness and numerical-identity verdicts are structurally null

goods.name: Standing & Accountability Builder
goods.audience: providers, developers, operators, auditors and researchers who need a local two-ledger review artifact
goods.problem: A standing/accountability review can remain vague prose unless claims, accountability events, cross-links, review routes, recovery ownership and explicit unknowns are captured in a portable structure.
distinctive_value: builds the two-ledger sidecar entirely in the browser without uploading case material
performs deterministic semantic checks for missing review routes, principal traceability, transition authority and recovery ownership while allowing explicit uncertainty
hard-codes legal, personhood, consciousness and identity verdicts to not_determined
exports a durable JSON artifact that can be validated against the open schema and conformance corpus

impact.note: No centralized usage analytics are collected, so use is not converted into an invented impact count.

law: Free resolution is success; core common goods do not auto-paywall.
